verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago documents broad programmatic coverage. Its CLI operates payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores and reports from a single token, with no browser or visual interface needed. It also documents APIs for checkout orders and POS machines, and an MCP server for test users and webhook configuration. However, nothing claims full API parity with the UI, and several UI features have no API evidence. missing for 10: explicit statement of API/UI parity, API evidence for app features such as transfers, QR payments, yields and account management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coverage breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With a single token, you can operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores, and reports without a browser, visual interface client, or manual HTTP calls.
Incorporate a flexible API into your website so that customers can shop on your website or app without being redirected to an external page.
Connect the POS machine APIs and manage payments in one place.
